arguments.prompt: Create an original game-ready painted/cartoon soft-shaded fantasy Chinese cultivation village TERRAIN FLOOR ONLY image, square 1024x1024 pixels. Top-down orthographic ground, compatible with chibi anime 3/4 MMORPG sprites. NOT pixel art. Gentle warm jade-green grass with delicate organic varied texture, broad pale sandy stone paths forming a cross, an open circular pale stone central plaza centered at (512,512) of radius about 180px. Cross paths extend to all four edges, width about 140px. Ground entirely flat and traversable. NO houses, trees, rocks, characters, mountains, shadows, raised objects, text, icons, grid or logos. Terrain fills entire canvas opaque. Cohesive hand-painted soft shading, clear at gameplay scale. This is terrain for starter_village; houses and trees will be separately layered, so absolutely only grass/flat paths/plaza.

Create an original transparent PNG prop atlas with exactly TWO isolated painted/cartoon soft-shaded objects for a Chinese fantasy cultivation chibi MMORPG, matching the attached terrain palette. NOT pixel art. Top-down 3/4 orthographic, clean soft-shaded detail. LEFT HALF: a small village wooden house with warm plaster walls, teal curved tiled roof, visible south/front door and foundation, no weapon or character. RIGHT HALF: one leafy green tree with clearly visible brown trunk/root and broad canopy above. Each object entirely contained in its own half with at least 50 pixels clear transparent margin on all sides, separated by wide empty transparent space. No ground/grass, no floor, no baked ground shadow, no labels/grid/text/logo. Objects must be opaque except transparent cutout edges and empty background. Requested canvas square 1024x1024; house and tree approximately same total pixel height, house about 420px tall and tree about 480px tall. Consistent soft sunlight from upper left. True alpha transparent background, suitable for independently layered game props.

Edit this prop atlas preserving the exact house and tree identity, painted soft shading, colors and camera. Resize EACH object to 70 percent of its current size, reposition the HOUSE fully within the LEFT HALF centered horizontally there, and the TREE fully within the RIGHT HALF centered horizontally there. Keep their bottom baselines aligned around 80 percent canvas height. There must be at least 100 pixels completely transparent clear space between the two objects and at least 60 pixels alpha-transparent margin on all four outer sides. No overlap between object pixels; do not add terrain, shadows, text or new objects. True transparent alpha background. This is a two-column sprite atlas that will be sliced in half; absolutely no object may cross the central vertical boundary.
